research.title: Heart Attack Prediction using Machine Learning
research.description: Comprehensive analysis of cardiovascular risk factors using ensemble learning methods to predict heart attack probability.
research.methodology: We employed a combination of Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, and Neural Networks to build an ensemble model. The dataset was preprocessed using feature engineering techniques including normalization and handling missing values.
findings: Age and cholesterol levels are the strongest predictors
Ensemble methods outperform single classifiers by 12%
Early detection can reduce mortality by 40%

research.title: Cardiovascular Disease Risk Visualization
research.description: Interactive visualizations exploring correlations between lifestyle factors and heart disease risk across different demographics.
research.methodology: Data visualization using D3.js and Plotly to create interactive dashboards showing relationships between variables.
findings: Strong correlation between smoking and heart disease
Gender differences in risk factors identified

research.title: Statistical Analysis of CVD Symptoms
research.description: In-depth statistical analysis of symptom presentation patterns across different cardiovascular conditions.
research.methodology: Statistical analysis using hypothesis testing, correlation analysis, and regression modeling to identify symptom patterns.
findings: Chest pain is present in 85% of acute cases
Fatigue as early warning sign often overlooked
Symptom clustering varies by age group

research.title: Heart Disease UCI Dataset
research.description: Curated dataset combining heart disease data from Cleveland, Hungary, Switzerland, and VA Long Beach.
research.methodology: Data cleaning, integration, and standardization of multiple international heart disease databases.

research.title: Deep Learning for ECG Analysis
research.description: Convolutional neural network model for automated detection of arrhythmias from ECG signals.
research.methodology: CNN architecture with residual connections trained on PhysioNet ECG database for multi-class arrhythmia classification.

research.title: Global CVD Mortality Trends
research.description: Analysis of cardiovascular disease mortality trends across different countries and time periods.
research.methodology: Time series analysis and geospatial visualization of WHO mortality data spanning 30 years.
findings: Mortality rates declining in developed nations
